retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome composition featuring an intimate close-up of two figures against a void-like black background with elegant, wide-tracked serif typography.
triggerTerms: cinematic black and white album cover
excludeWhen: casual or playful themes are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A dramatic, low-key black and white photograph of a couple in an intimate embrace, emerging from a deep black void. The lighting is directional, creating sharp highlights on skin and hair while losing the background to total darkness. The typography is anchored at the bottom, using a sophisticated serif for the main title and a clean sans-serif for secondary information.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast relationship between subject highlights and deep black negative space
Intimate proximity between subjects creating a central focal point
Horizontal typographic anchor balancing the verticality of the subjects
Texture contrast between soft skin, hair, and fabric

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are centered and tightly cropped, occupying the upper two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The main title text at the bottom serves as the structural base for the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the faces of the subjects, follows the curve of the embrace downward, and rests on the bold typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive use of black negative space surrounding the subjects to create a sense of isolation and focus.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black background for depth and drama.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for typography and highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone greys for skin texture and fabric detail.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between highlights and shadows.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Classical Roman serif with high stroke contrast.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for the title paired with a wide-tracked, small-scale sans-serif for metadata.
graphicDevices: Subtle gradient fade at the bottom of the image to ensure text legibility.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary high contrast and elegance for the display title.
Clean geometric forms for the wide-tracked subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, low-key black and white photograph of a couple in an intimate embrace. Use a single light source from the side to create dramatic highlights on their faces and shoulders, while the rest of the scene fades into a pure black background. Leave the bottom 20% of the frame clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a large, white, high-contrast serif font (all caps) centered near the bottom. Below it, add a secondary line of text in a small, grey, geometric sans-serif font with extra-wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the main title font a high-contrast serif?
Is the subtitle tracking significantly wider than the title?

adjustableVariables: Vertical position of the text block
mustRedesign: Do not include background elements like furniture or walls
Do not use lowercase letters in the typography

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the subjects' faces

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no color cast is present in the grayscale.
Check that the text is perfectly centered horizontally.
Verify that the black background is deep and uniform.
Confirm the serif font has sharp, distinct terminals.
recipe.reuseFormula: Intimate monochrome portrait + low-key lighting + high-contrast serif typography = Cinematic Romance Aesthetic.
